title: 4/14 deploy run green while git pull failed on box-local uv.lock drift; services restarted on stale code
tier_reason: the deploy path reported success while the box kept stale code, so a shipped change silently did not take effect (deploy recoverability); the evidenced stale window (about 14 min, 4/14 19:33–19:47 ET) carried the catboost dependency and experiment code, not a production-path change

contract.text: A deploy run fails loudly unless the pushed commit is installed (pull and locked dependency sync) and the services restart on it.
contract.source: .github/workflows/deploy.yml at 51ef987 ('Deployed <sha>') and at 6bffd63 (set -e; sudo -Hu bts git pull --ff-only; uv sync --locked --extra model); 6bffd63 body

mechanism.text: the box's uv had no exclude-newer setting while the Mac's user config had a relative 'exclude-newer = 3 days', so every `uv run` on the box rewrote uv.lock (dropping its [options] section), leaving a local modification

the catboost commit (6e1256e) changed uv.lock, so git pull --ff-only refused to overwrite the locally modified file; the workflow had no set -e, so it restarted the services on the old code and the run concluded success

verified_recovered.how: deploy run 24428702189 (head 6bffd63) concluded success under the new set -e workflow, so its git pull and uv sync --locked exited 0

residual.text: exclude-newer is now an absolute date that must be advanced by hand; drift now fails the deploy loudly (uv sync --locked under set -e) instead of silently

watchdog.trigger: after a deploy run concludes success, the box's HEAD differs from the run's head SHA, the working tree is dirty, or the running scheduler started before the run
watchdog.recovery_assertion: box HEAD equals the pushed SHA, the tree is clean, `uv sync --locked` passes, and one scheduler started after the run

evidence.what: the box's uv dropped uv.lock's [options] section on every `uv run`; every commit touching uv.lock silently failed `git pull --ff-only`; with no set -e the services restarted on stale code while the run showed green; 'This session's catboost commit was the first uv.lock change in 3 days and tripped it'
head 7fa90b4 (contains the catboost commit 6e1256e), created 2026-04-14T23:33:57Z, concluded success; log expired
head 6bffd63, created 2026-04-14T23:47:55Z, concluded success under the set -e workflow; log expired

evidence.locator: commit 6e1256e 'chore(deps): add catboost to model extra' (2026-04-14T19:32:04-04:00)
evidence.what: the first uv.lock change pushed after the box started rewriting uv.lock

notes: the 6bffd63 pull could succeed only if the box's modified uv.lock was reset first; that operator step is not recorded (mitigation unknown)
tier A reads 'loss of recoverability' as 'the deploy path silently did not take effect' (consistent with I-018); the lead may prefer B because nothing production-relevant was stranded
